Add testing story for HIPAA compliance validation

SHARED-F-2-S130.title: Consent Schema & Persistence Model
SHARED-F-2-S130.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and Pydantic contracts for two-tier consent (Tier 1 anonymous, Tier 2 identifiable), including timestamps, versioning, and audit fields to support HIPAA-compliant storage decisions.

SHARED-F-2-S131.title: Consent Core Logic Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S131.description: Implement enforcement logic within consent_service to evaluate consent tier at runtime and gate data storage, triggering de-identification for Tier 1 and allowing identifiable persistence only under Tier 2.

SHARED-F-2-S132.title: Consent Testing & HIPAA Validation
SHARED-F-2-S132.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier behavior, including correct de-identification under Tier 1, proper data persistence under Tier 2, and prevention of unauthorized identifiable storage.
